scope: Current official GitHub documentation checked read-only. No credentials requested or exposed, no mutation issued.

claims: Create-blob accepts UTF-8 or base64 content and returns a blob SHA.
The page's 100 MB note occurs under Get a blob; it is not evidence of a connector create-request ceiling.
Create-tree entries can provide content or a blob SHA, but not both.
base_tree preserves its other entries while supplied paths replace matching entries.
Omitting base_tree creates a tree containing only supplied entries; publishing that partial tree could delete other tracked paths.
Get-tree's recursive response may be truncated; its documented 100,000-entry/7 MB limits are read-response limits, not stated create-request limits.
General secondary content-creation guidance is at most 80 requests per minute and 500 per hour; some endpoints may be lower, shared limits and undisclosed limits also apply.
Use response headers and honor retry-after or rate-limit reset; after a secondary limit without a provided interval, wait at least one minute, then increase backoff if needed.
These limits do not establish available quota for the active connector.
